events.content: The route is correctly marked as `ƒ (Dynamic)` in the build output — not `○ (Static)`. The key piece is `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` in `app/page.tsx:1`, which tells Next.js to opt out of static prerendering and server-render the page on every request, producing a fresh `new Date().toISOString()` timestamp each time.

part.text: The route is correctly marked as `ƒ (Dynamic)` in the build output — not `○ (Static)`. The key piece is `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` in `app/page.tsx:1`, which tells Next.js to opt out of static prerendering and server-render the page on every request, producing a fresh `new Date().toISOString()` timestamp each time.
